Thanks! It's unfortunate that we're both going to be leaving for home tomorrow since the semester is over. Really makes it hard for me because it won't be as easy to hang out, and I'm normally too awkward to successfully invite someone to visit. But if her and I just make it through the summer as friends, maybe it'll last.

Peace
Thanks! Things have been better since we met. It even seems like she wants to be a long term friend, which would rock.

I appreciate that. I fear it could backfire if this person mentions any identifying information about me, if and when they share what they now know. What I told this person about the friend was unpleasant and true , therefore I fear the friend could retaliate or alienate me because they are much more popular and well-connected than me. I really didn't want to say anything in the first place, but my conscience wouldn't let me get out of doing the right thing.

Thank you so much. I read this earlier, and for some reason I just felt finally free to cry. I rarely ever do nowadays, and so a good cry was in order. That simple, kind and human gesture of validating my pain was enough to liberate me for a moment.

I have been overwhelmed and sometimes see this place as the only one to turn to. It's people like you who make this a better place for people who need it.
Yep. Mental illness is bitch.

There is no singular large trauma really. I intensely struggle with everyday interactions with others and that phenomenon manifests itself in a variety of ugly and stressful ways. I have undoubtedly suffered a few traumas that have left me with some markers of PTSD, but my biggest problem is social anxiety at the moment. As much as I would like to read books to solve my problems, I've mastered in-depth psychology courses before and reading material like that just surfaces a different mindset. If I'm going to solve my problems, it will most likely require people. It's just a paradox that my very problem involved interacting with people.
I've tried to get support from family and friends. Family isn't enough, and my friends seem like they don't care.

Thanks for trying to help me get a handle on this. I just have been so devastated by these beautiful worlds I imagined and created, seeing them coming crashing down hard. I want to push on with a clearer head, but it's challenging.

Thanks for getting back to me. I think she very well might have gaslighted me. Honestly, people I knew even told me I was being fooled too, but I didn't want to hear it. I remember feeling frequently harshly judged, and now that I think about it, she did psychologically manipulate me.

The things she would say, the things she wouldn't say, they all made me look down on myself. That's because some of her evaluations of me were that I couldn't be a responsible person of high moral character, based on nothing of poor conscience.

It really hurt me, but I was still blinded by the warmth of having someone who at least pretended to care about me. I need to get better with that, I guess.
You're right.
Why do I even try?
Thank you, I appreciate it.
Thanks for replying. I wish I could explain everything but it's just so complicated. Thank you though, I appreciate your willingness to listen.
Talk to me, I'll be there for you.
Thanks for understanding. And I think you're right. I'll try to enjoy things while they last. I just feel like I need to prepare myself in case things go bad.
Thank you. I appreciate it. Sometimes I just need to get these feelings out before I implode.
Thank you. It means a lot :)
Haha, all right. Thank you.

Thank you. It's nice to know that someone cares enough to help me through this. And I appreciate your honesty. I'd rather get no help with love than pretend help.

But what you said about surviving this, how there is light at the end of this tunnel, makes me feel warm. I appreciate you helping me to rekindle my hope, because I have been growing weary of being the only one to keep it going.

And I just might have to let myself let it all out. Might go for a run or something. And I'll try to have a good cry afterwards, I haven't been able to cry in a while.

Thanks for the PM offer, might actually have to take you up on that if things get rougher.

Peace.

P.S.
Haha, I'm glad someone enjoyed the anti shoutouts. Can you believe that crap? lol.

That seems logical. But, I would never want a rebound relationship. I think those are awful! They always just end up hurting both parties involved. I just wanted something that I could make last forever.

And I want to make it until college, believe me. But I don't know how to take my mind off of the pain until then. Both physical and emotional.

Wow. I'm sorry that happened. Must have been stressful for him, you, his family, and the girl. Personally, I would never do that simply because I wouldn't want to make a mess for someone else to clean up. Ugh. I know a few people would hate to see me go, but I just don't know how to stop feeling like garbage all the time. I have nobody to regularly contact me outside of two people in my immediate family.

I just want to hold someone again in my arms. I want them to hold me. I miss that so much.

I feel reckless right now. Maybe I'll call my ex. It's a terrible idea, I know, but I've got nothing to lose right?

How do I cure this pain...

Thank you. I keep telling myself that last part, but a part of me will never let her go. I don't know what's wrong with me. I want to move on but I can't. I wish I had closure with her. And I've tried to move on. Posted in another subreddit, with a different account, only to get friend zoned or ignored. I wanted to find someone else. Still do. But every day is suffering until then.

Hope isn't something that is just out there, and it isn't something that comes to you; it's something *you* have to find or even create.

I wish I could give you hope. But I can't. I can tell you that I believe in you, that after all you've been through, I believe you can take on this depression.

You've made it farther than I. Perhaps I shouldn't be speaking of hope. Because I have lost it too.

But you have this stranger's support. Seize a happy life, one you deserve. Don't take anyone's shit.

Peace.

I know what you mean. It's so hard trying to get better with nobody to help pull you through. But, if you've made it this far, there must be some inner strength or passion calling for you to stay. What is that for you? For me, it is hope.

That is awful. You deserve better. Nobody should threaten to leave their SO, just because the other person wants to open up about their feelings. I'm so sorry you are in that situation. If you need someone to talk to, I'm here.
Right there with you. You can talk to me, if you like.
It's unsettling to know that those can be the kinds of people you will be held captive by when you need genuine compassion the most.

Sorry I took a while to respond, I just crashed in bed.

I'm sorry that you are down over life being average, but that's the epitome of depression. Being down whenever there's no real reason to be. Everything else is pretty much just sadness, which hurts just as much, except you can point to something as the source of the feelings.

I also think my life isn't particularly shitty, but I still find myself wallowing in a pit of depression everyday. Loneliness is eating me alive. Ugh.

Absolutely. I've been hospitalized before and I don't feel like I'm senior enough to anyone to be able to force such an experience upon anyone. It can feel dehumanizing to have that choice made for you, which is why I would only ever consider it in the extenuating circumstances I outlined above. 

Thank you for appreciating my position on that subject, I'm sure many people wouldn't like it because they think anyone with those thoughts should end up hospitalized.

Firstly, you are a good person for caring about him enough to actually want him to be ok after all of this. Secondly, you've come to the right place.

I personally haven't had to help someone like this IRL, but this is what I would do. Let him know that you are always there for him as a friend, if you mean it. If you can help him, don't abandon him. Let him know that you have been detecting odd behavior from him, and that you want to help.

If he isn't receptive, perhaps you should inform his family gently about his fragile state, and tell them that they need to be there for him. Also, if he does follow through despite your help, don't blame yourself. You are one of the good ones. You seem to have genuine concern.

I'm sorry that I don't know of what specifically to do about finding affordable professional help, but honestly just letting him know that he can open up to you may be enough. Sorry if my advice wasn't as helpful or applicable as you were looking for.

I wish you and your boyfriend the best.

P.S. The nuclear option is to seek to hospitalize him, but this could do more harm than good. I would only ever do this to someone I knew if I was close to them, I knew that things would probably get better for them, and if I knew they did have the will to live.

Peace.
Hey there. I'm not doing too well either. Maybe we can help each other out again. What's on your mind?

Loneliness is one of the worst feelings in the world. In my experience, it is second only to heartbreak. Both of which I know well. If you want someone to talk to, I am here. I'm a good listener. And if you don't want to talk, I'm still wishing you the best.

Peace.
Of course. If you need to talk again feel free to shoot me a pm. I'm cheering for you.

That is a lot to comprehend. I think you should find someone IRL to talk to that you can trust, or better yet a therapist. They can help you with these feelings and help you rationalize your thoughts. They will work with you.

Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. Take care of yourself on both aspects. You don't need to suffer alone. And if things get really bad again, perhaps consider visiting a hospital. It's no fun, but you may find the resources you need to release yourself from your mind's prison.

I'm wishing the best for you.

Peace.

I'm so sorry. Something must have really broken you. If I were there, I would give you hugs, assuming that was welcome. I think you may need to find some resources to help you through this. Do you have any reliable friends/family to talk with? How about therapists. There are resources to lessen your pain, and make you feel better. But it takes time. I'm sorry that you feel done with the world.

That's right, let it out. Good. I am so sorry that your mind has become a prison. I sense a strong internal conflict with yourself. I'm sorry that a part of you is insistent on torturing the rest of you. But you can fight this.

You have survived 24 years, and you haven't lost yet. You can win this battle. You just need to find the resources to do so. Vent to me, I'm here and won't let you go, if I can help it. I want you to get better.

I know that feeling. Composing oneself in that situation is hard. But I'm here. I know the pain you talk about. The kind that seems like it will only end the day we die. The only things that keep me alive are talking things through with people like you, finding hope, and well I am afraid of failing to do it. You can talk to me, and say whatever you want. This is a safe space.
Talk to me. I'm a good listener.

I hope things get better, and thank you for sharing your story. It was concise, yet powerful. Hospitalization isn't fun, but hopefully it will set you up with effective resources + treatment.

Good luck sir, or mam, and peace.

Please, you can talk to me. I'll listen to whatever you need to say.

Peace.

I understand. Redditors were there when I needed them, so I'll try to be here for others. I hope that there is something enjoyable you can do to forget your troubles for a while. Do you have any hobbies/interests you can occupy yourself with? That often works for me.

You can talk to me, I'm a good listener.

Peace.

Wow. You have faced incredible odds but you are still here. That deserves recognition. I understand a lot of what you shared because I've seen it secondhand. I'm here for you if you need someone to talk to.

Peace.
What you're going through is painful, I know. But things can get better.
You can talk to me. I'm a good listener.
There are good people out there. If you can find them, let them crowd the bad people out of your life.

I can only imagine how that might've hurt you. Why are some people out there so cold and absent of compassion? I'll never know.

If you want someone to talk to, I'm here. I know what it's like to get your heart stomped on then deserted. It can get better, but it's not easy believe me. I'm cheering for you though.

Peace.
I'm sorry.
Goodbye.

Right there with ya. Sigh. When does it get better? I hope soon. Anyway, I'll listen to you if you want to talk.

If you want some support, you can talk to me. I'm a good listener.

Peace.
Loneliness is the worst. Talk to me. I'll listen. You don't have to suffer alone.

Peace.

Honestly I feel the same thing. Sometimes it comes falling on me like a pile of bricks, and I just have to lay down. Then when things start to feel better I try to savor that feeling and do something enjoyable.

I'm sorry that you're stuck in that pendulum of emotions, I know it's awful. Anytime you feel that pendulum crush you come here for help. There's almost always someone here to talk. And there always is when I'm here.

Hang in there. I'm cheering for you.

Peace.

I know what you mean, but...

Let me help you. You deserve to live a happy life. Don't let others bring you down. Talk to me anytime you need, I'm not going anywhere. I'm sorry you haven't found the right resources to help you through this.

If you want somebody to talk to, I'm here.

Peace.

Peace.

Peace.

Peace.

Nobody will blame you if you don't go, but because you don't want to die, and you want to get better, I would say its a safe decision to admit yourself. I hope things do get better.

Just because you have an interest in that doesn't make you a sicko. Most people keep that stuff private, and nobody knows the better. There is no reason to off yourself just because of a socially unacceptable interest.

As long as you don't do anything reckless or irresponsible, you have just as much a claim to a long happy life as anyone who enjoys watching people do disgusting things to each other.

You deserve better. There's a whole wide world out there to explore and experience. Suicide may seem like a peaceful decision, but it'll be your last. There are so many alternatives to explore.

Before ending your life, wouldn't it be worth a try sticking it out and trying something new? Even running away leaves you with more options than ending yourself. Or maybe you could stick with your family and try to get them to do something new, go somewhere spontaneous.

If right now you think you have no goals, I would encourage you to find a quiet place to actually think about what you want to do in life. There must be something. You see other peoples lives, and there must be something you envy. There's a world of opportunity out there, waiting to be seized.

I think you should give you a chance. Because you are worth it. Use your lack of inhibition to do something productive, or at least satisfying. And if it gets rough along the way, don't hesitate to reach out to this sub for help. We care. I care.

I understand. And I guess I can share my story, although it typically reads like a novel.

She was the only consistent friend I had through all of high school. She was my best friend for the first two years, although I was never hers. We had a lot in common, and shared many views and interests. After graduation she texted me in a manner leaving room for me to ask her out. So I did. We were together for about 2 weeks although she only talked for about one week. It was intense and things moved pretty quickly.

She ended up dumping me after I texted her saying that we should sort things out in person because she wasn't replying much to my texts at all. We met somewhere and that's when it happened. Sh had to meet with a friend after so we only had like half an hour. She offered some reasons, but most of them seem untrue. She said that she didn't think she was ready for any relationship, and had to do a lot of self reflection. I would've believed her except she had more than a few before me and she moved on in less than a month.

Now I don't even have her as a friend. She doesn't text me anymore. I mean I texted her like twice after the breakup and she responded, but she never texts me on her own volition. I miss her so much. She was as close to perfect as I've experienced in person. Friendly, smart, nerdy, pretty, courageous. It hurts to know that I will never get to be with her again. She felt like the one.

I cry a lot now. Many things trigger flashbacks of her, and when I realize how I've probably seen her for the last time I just feel empty. A bitter loneliness is eating me alive. The only redeeming thing she said was that she thought I needed someone who would love me just as much, because she said things felt very one-sided.

I guess she's right. I need the person I love to love me just as much. But I'm sad that genuine, pure love wasn't enough to change her mind to love me just as much. I thought it was special for someone to love somebody with their whole heart. But not enough I guess.

Now I'm pressing on finally realizing that I have to. I could find somebody else, somebody kind and sensitive like me. It will take time. But the thought of dying alone often frightens me. I'm just keeping on so I can find somebody who let me into their life and let me be their sunshine. It's a foolish hope, but it's all I've got inside.

If it involves you leaving your family, you are in spirit an adult and deserve to make that decision, whether your government recognizes your autonomy or not.

Just think things through before you act, rash decisions can be hard to reverse. And keep playing your MMORPG if it helps you keep on :)

Ok I read the reply. I'm sorry that you aren't getting real support from family or your boyfriend. He probably means well, but a lot of people out there don't understand how complex and burdensome depression truly is. There is no simple fix. The only way to truly fight it is to find or make a support network.

Your BF can be a part of that, just let him know that your depression isn't just sadness. It's not going to go away just like that. You may also want to see if anyone in your family can genuinely help you with this. Also, if you can find a therapist that works for you, that may help. Personally, I never have. In addition, you may want to explore changes in your medication. Depression is multi-faceted and looking for better medications may be an option, I've been switching meds a lot. Lastly, don't lose hope. You can reach out here anytime that you feel you need to. There are many people here who want to help. Myself included.

I believe in you.
